svg.title: MARIBOR / MODULAR MODEL KIT
svg.text: Blender environment reference + editable construction proposal / no meshes or Unity scenes delivered
Three facade models, one car base, shared
Full-level image is not a scale drawing.
Three reusable facade fronts plus corners and roof
One compact car mesh with upright/overturned
Separate road, curb-ramp, riverbank edge, railing
Facade/rail boundaries are coarse boxes, not
Overturned cars use a few boxes; keep movement
Water is a visual plane behind a physical
boundary, with no new swimming rule.
Keep side-escape aperture and tunnel corner
Snap module origins to meter grid; use shared bay
Streetlamp emitter does not imply every lamp needs
Spawn/pickup markers are empty transforms separate
Keep car-ramp collision distinct from the
Meters; Unity +Y up. Floor modules originate on finished floor Y = 0.
Separate render geometry, simple collision and semantic markers.
4 m bays and all new dimensions are proposals; test actual player/camera.
Use MODULE_CATALOG.md for all 50 module extents, pivots and collision targets.
Art lighting is mood reference. Build with the project's few-light and short-view-distance constraints.
Canonical gameplay: docs/Gameplay.md · source prompts: source-prompts.json · integration: UNITY_WORLD_HANDOFF.md
